name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2004 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2004 record supports: CERT/CC's CA-2004-01 and CA-2004-02 (the H.323 flaws, Bagle and MyDoom), the US-CERT alerts on MyDoom.B, Phatbot, MyDoom.M/O, the IE flaws behind Download.Ject and Bofra, and Santy.A against phpBB, F-Secure's records of Bagle, MyDoom and Sasser, CAIDA's analysis of the destructive Witty worm, Microsoft's bulletins and Download.Ject statement, the FTC's spyware case and the Justice Department releases on CAN-SPAM, Hill, Tereshchuk, Web Snare, Ingram Micro, Shadowcrew and the Lowe's wireless intrusion, plus APT1's domain registrations, which ATT&CK lists for G0006 and Mandiant dates to 2004. Apart from T1583.001, no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id: every other entry is this study's later mapping. The object-level techniques of Uroburos, WEBC2 and Equation are not in this layer. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md. Scores: 100 ATT&CK lists the id for the group, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 the mapping is Inferred.

techniques.comment: Sasser scans random addresses on TCP 445 (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [43] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

Address harvesting from address books and files (CA-2004-02); MyDoom.M/O searches on harvested addresses (26 Jul) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [1][46] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

MyDoom's backdoor can act as a proxy (F-Secure) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [35] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

Bagle's backdoor downloads and runs programs (18 Jan); backdoors used to download DDoS tools (CA-2004-02) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [34][1] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

Download.Ject's compromised servers deliver code to visitors (Jun); Bofra (Nov); spyware installed through an IE feature (FTC, 12 Oct, alleged) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [44][45][23][70] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

Witty's single UDP packet to ISS PAM (19 Mar); Download.Ject on IIS 5.0 servers without MS04-011 (24 Jun); Santy.A on phpBB (21 Dec) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [37][38][44][28] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

CAN-2004-0549 exploited (TA04-163A, 11 Jun; MS04-025); CAN-2004-1050 exploited (MS04-040, 1 Dec) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [17][18][25] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

CA-2004-02: the mailers spread through social engineering and human action (27 Jan) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [1] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

Sasser through LSASS (about 1 May); Phatbot through unpatched Windows flaws (19 Mar); Witty host to host (19 Mar) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [43][36][37][38] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.
Santy.A defaces web files (21 Dec) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [28] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

MyDoom's scheduled SCO flood (from 1 Feb); MyDoom.B designed to attack microsoft.com; Echouafni's hired DDoS (Web Snare, 26 Aug, alleged); the bookmaker attacks (Reported) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [35][33][69][64][119] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

Witty writes data to random disk locations and overwrites sections of the hard drive (19 Mar) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [37][38] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

Mass-mailed, not targeted, so the closest fit only: Bagle and Novarg attachments (CA-2004-02, 27 Jan); MyDoom.B (SA04-028A, 28 Jan) (basis: Inferred; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [1][32] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

Bofra spread through links in e-mail (TA04-315A, 10 Nov) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [24] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

ATT&CK lists it for APT1 (G0006); Mandiant dates the first APT1 zone, hugesoft.org, to 25 Oct 2004 (basis: Listed (group); ATT&CK lists the id for APT1 (G0006)). Sources [108][107] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

Phatbot controls large numbers of systems (SA04-079A, 19 Mar); compromised home machines used for DDoS and spam (CA-2004-02) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [36][1] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

Santy.A finds targets through search-engine keyword queries (21 Dec) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [28] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

Hill's spam posing as AOL and PayPal sent victims to a look-alike billing page (sentenced 17 May); CA-2004-02's definition of phishing (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [63][1] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

Hill's phishing fraud (17 May); Tereshchuk's $17 million demand (from 3 Feb); Ingram Micro orders (4 Aug, alleged); Shadowcrew card trafficking (28 Oct, alleged) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [63][61][67][71] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

The Lowe's store wireless network (2003 conduct; sentence 15 Dec 2004); Tereshchuk's mail through unsecured wireless networks (plea 8 Jun) is a weaker fit (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [74][61][118] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

MyDoom.B spoofs From addresses (28 Jan); the first CAN-SPAM charges and FTC cases over false headers and forged sender addresses (29 Apr, alleged). T1672 is revoked and superseded by T1684.002 (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [32][57][58][122] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.

MyDoom.B blocks anti-virus vendor sites and may stop anti-virus updates (28 and 29 Jan); blocking updates is a loose fit. T1562.001 is revoked and superseded by T1685 (basis: Inferred; a later mapping, since no 2004 source prints an ATT&CK id). Sources [33][32][122] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2004.md.
